bead.title: Add ProjectionImage import export seam
bead.description: Add the recovery image seam required by hybrid. In pqueue-projection, define a typed ProjectionImage that can fully represent a queue projection at a high-water: item lifecycle/state, client keys, priority/order metadata, lease state, fields/payload/metadata/gates/entity docs, secondary and typed indexes, side records, instance fences, paused state, and any data needed to reproduce metrics. Add ProjectionData::to_image and ProjectionData::from_image or equivalent narrow APIs, plus InMemoryProjection::hydrate_shard. In pqueue-sqlite, add SqliteProjectionStore::export_projection_image(shard) that reads the durable SQLite projection into the image. Out of scope: server env wiring and objectlog runtime selection.
bead.acceptance:
1. cargo test -p pqueue-projection projection_image -- --nocapture passes.
2. cargo test -p pqueue-sqlite sqlite_projection_image -- --nocapture passes.
3. cargo test -p pqueue-sqlite --test sqlite_projection_tests -- --nocapture passes.
4. cargo fmt --check passes.
